metric: script invocation to mock paste dispatch, not editor delivery
method: 99th percentile of 10000 bootstrap batches; seed=0; baseline only
caveats: Pilot thresholds from two rounds, not a long-term false-positive guarantee.
The p95 allowance is particularly uncertain with only 40 baseline samples.
Wayland uses private headless Mutter with Xwayland disabled and actual GTK delivery checks.
X11 uses private Xvfb and mocked key dispatch, not editor delivery.
Isolated compositor timings are not live-desktop latency estimates.
Never regenerate these thresholds from the code being evaluated.
